label: From processes to cells
subgoals: Turn each signal's decision tree into a multiplexer tree
Turn each clock-edge sync rule into a flip-flop
Run proc before any netlist optimization

label: The sub-passes
subgoals: Clean dead branches before building multiplexers
Detect asynchronous resets before creating flip-flops
Create latches and flip-flops after the multiplexer trees exist

label: Reading what proc produced
subgoals: Trace an unexpected latch to an output missing on some path
Suspect reset recognition when a flip-flop lacks its reset pin
Expect the optimizer to shrink proc's multiplexer trees
